headlines.headline: LAKERS' RECORD $12 BILLION SALE CLOSES AS LUKA DONCIC SITS OUT INDEFINITELY
headlines.detail: ESPN reports the Lakers' ownership sale has closed at a record $12 billion NBA valuation, even as the team opens the preseason without Luka Doncic — ruled out indefinitely by coach JJ Redick — and with LeBron James reportedly managing chronic arthritis. Elsewhere, 18-year veteran Russell Westbrook announced his retirement, and the NBA Cup group-stage schedule kicks off Oct. 30 with the Lakers at the Warriors.

headlines.headline: 49ERS STAY UNBEATEN AT 5-0; SEAHAWKS HOST THURSDAY NIGHT SHOWDOWN AT BRONCOS TONIGHT
headlines.detail: San Francisco improved to 5-0 Sunday, rallying from a fourth-quarter deficit to beat Seattle 32-29 and drop the Seahawks to 3-2. Seattle visits Denver tonight for Thursday Night Football (8:15 p.m. ET), with both teams debuting throwback uniforms for the Week 6 matchup.

headlines.headline: GEORGIA HOLDS NO. 1 IN AP POLL AS HUSKIES DROP TO 3-3 AHEAD OF FRIDAY AT PURDUE
headlines.detail: Georgia (6-0) remains No. 1 in this week's AP Top 25 with Notre Dame, Miami, Ohio State, and Indiana rounding out the top five, while Texas and Oregon continue to slide. Washington fell to 3-3 (0-3 Big Ten) in a blowout loss to No. 20 Iowa and visits Purdue Friday, Oct. 16 — the Huskies' first trip to West Lafayette since 1990.

headlines.headline: FLORIDA TOPS PRESEASON TOP 25 AS MICHIGAN AND UCONN OPEN NEW ERAS WITH TIP-OFF THREE WEEKS AWAY
headlines.detail: With the Nov. 2 opener roughly three weeks out, ESPN's preseason Top 25 projects Florida at No. 1, while KenPom's model favors Duke. Reigning champion Michigan and runner-up UConn both enter the season under heavy roster turnover, and the AP's official preseason poll has not yet been released.
